name: DesignCraft
summary: Edit page layouts in Nextcloud with DesignCraft
description:
Open a DesignCraft document or an IDML package in Files with **Edit in DesignCraft** and work on it right in the browser: pages and spreads, master pages, text frames and threaded stories, paragraph and character styles, pictures, colours and swatches, tables and exports.

- **Save** writes a DesignCraft document straight back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. An IDML package is saved as a new DesignCraft document next to it (you pick the name and folder); **File › Export › IDML** writes the .idml back.
- **Export** (PDF, PNG, EPUB, text) stores a file in any folder you pick.
- Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy.
- If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy.
- Optionally, clicking a document in Files opens it in DesignCraft.
readme_features:
- **Edit in DesignCraft** appears in the Files action menu of every DesignCraft document (.designcraft) and IDML package (.idml) you can read.
- **Save** (Ctrl/⌘+S) writes a DesignCraft document back to Nextcloud, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. An IDML package is saved as a DesignCraft document: the first time, you pick the name and folder (it's offered next to the original), and later saves go to that file. **File › Export › IDML** writes the .idml back under its own name.
- **Export** (PDF, PNG, EPUB, text) asks for a name and folder in your Nextcloud the first time.
readme_limitations: - Pictures a document links to by path, rather than embeds, aren't loaded from your Nextcloud: place them again from your computer with **File › Place**.
new_format_hint: DesignCraft saves {name} in its own format (.designcraft), so it goes to a new file and the original stays as it is.
bridge_notes: With `?host=parent`, DesignCraft starts without the sample document, and the parent guards leaving the page with unsaved changes. Save hands the parent a `.designcraft` document and marks it saved, as DesignCraft's web build does after a download.
patch_extra: , plus an `unbranded` build feature that leaves out the ArtCraft mark (modified builds must not carry the ArtCraft marks)
